purpose: Native regression input for the frozen baseline worst temporal branch, evaluated before Collide. It includes the bound surface followed by the two authored colliders in native evaluation order at 89, 89.25, 89.5, 89.75 and 90. Geometry is material-free and is supplied in local, world and description space.

validationContract.lengthCheck: Compare remapped samples at their expected source-arc coordinates. Connecting chords may sum to less than the retained source-arc target. In stiff mode, collision preserves the resampled-prefix chord lengths.
